detail.title: 2MP 45x Starlight IR Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD5A245GB-HNR 2MP 45x Starlight IR Network PTZ Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 2MP Resolution • 45× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 150m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • AcuPick Enables Fast and Precise Human&Vehicle Search • Auto Tracking 3.0：Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • IP67 and IK10 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments • Supports PoE+ Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Color: 0.005 Lux@F1.6 B/W: 0.0005 Lux@F1.6 0Lux (IR light on)
General.Illuminator On/Off Control: Zoom Prio; Manual; Smart IR; Off
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –15° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; climbing fences; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification; linkage tracking
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, optimization, tracking, capturing pictures, uploading high-quality face snapshots, and face enhancement; Supports attributes extraction. 6 attributes and 8 expressions: Gender, age, glasses, expressions (angry, sad, hate, scary, surprise, calm, happy and confused), mask, mustache; Supports face cutout: Face, one-inch photo. Capturing strategies include real-time capturing, optimization, and quality first.
General.Video Metadata: Detects motor and non-motor vehicles, faces and human bodies. It also performs tracking, takes snapshots, uploads high-quality face images and optimizes images. It extracts attributes from motor vehicles, detecting up to 10 attributes for them.
General.People Counting: Uses advanced image processing technology to extract depth information from images. The extracted information is then processed by advanced, deep learning algorithms to analyze and detect human bodies, and track targets in real time. The camera provides statistics for separate individuals' entrance and exit with up to 95% counting accuracy.
General.Auto Patrol: It triggers the IVS rule when a target is detected and makes the camera link with the PTZ to rotate to the position of the target and patrol based on its presets.
General.Acupick: Uses deep learning algorithms and works with back-end devices to accurately match targets, such as people and motor vehicles, and search through live and recorded videos to quickly locate targets.
General.Video Compression: H.264H; H.264B; Smart H.265+; H.264; H.265; MJPEG(Sub Stream); Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 1080P/1.3M/720p@ (1–50/60 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF@ (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p (1–25/30 fps)
General.Video Bit Rate: H264: 64 kbps–10496 kbps H265: 25 kbps–6400 kbps
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view
General.Network Protocol: FTP; RTMP; IPv6; Bonjour; IPv4; DNS; RTCP; PPPoE; NTP; RTP; 802.1x; HTTPS; SNMP; TCP/IP; DDNS; UPnP; NFS; ICMP; UDP; IGMP; HTTP; SSL; DHCP; SMTP; Qos; RTSP; ARP
General.Storage: Micro SD card (Up to 512 GB); FTP; NAS
General.Browser: IE 9 and later versions Chrome 41 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions iOS 10 and later versions
General.Certifications: CE: EN55032/EN55024/EN50130-4 FCC: Part15 subpartB, ANSI C63.4-2014 UL: UL60950-1+CAN/CSA 22.2, No.60950-1
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; recording; send email; preset; tour; pattern; alarm digital output
General.Alarm Event: Motion/Tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Protection: IP67; IK10; TVS 6000V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
